stats.CASTING: Rapid-fire, delayed projectile that is accompanied by a spell field.

name: Spider-Sweeper
description: Enhance the SP//dr suit, Launching Up enemies in its path and deploying Arachno-Mines, Spider-Drones, and Cyber-Webs repeatedly. Spider-Drones inflict a Slow effect on hit, which can stack and refresh its effect period with multiple hits.

name: Cyber-Web Snare
description: Cast futuristic webbing that Immobilizes enemies or creates a Cyber-Web. While in the Cyber-Web, gain Healing Over Time and a Movement Boost. Excess healing converts into Bonus Health.

name: Bionic Spider-Nest
description: Generate a Bionic Spider-Nest at a targeted area, periodically spawning Spider-Drones and creating Cyber-Webs. While in the Cyber-Web, gain Healing Over Time and a Movement Boost. Excess healing converts into Bonus Health. Spider-Drones inflict a Slow effect on hit, which can stack and refresh its effect period with multiple hits.

name: Arachno-Mine
description: Deploy Arachno-Mines that can be concealed within the confines of a Cyber-Web.

name: Cyber-Bond
description: Shoot a web strand that links to the targeted area or Cyber-Web. If stretched too far, it will trigger a pullback.

name: Wall Crawl
description: Hold Space to crawl on vertical surfaces.

name: Spider-Tech
description: Cyber-Spiders Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging a Web-Cluster shot and granting Bonus Health.
